lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Tl2 (reduced formula LiTl) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with four atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Li and Tl centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per atom; Li is surrounded by 8 Li and 4 Tl neighbors (2.94–3.30 Å), while Tl has 6 Li and 6 Tl neighbors (3.27–3.30 Å). The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Li and Tl coordination polyhedra, though these relations are not exclusive.
